title: Pick me up
shortDescription: Robot is stuck and asks to be relocated.
fullDescription:
Neato D-series displays 'Pick me up' when wheels lose traction or the robot is wedged between obstacles. The LCD shows an arrow icon and audio prompts to relocate it.

Move the robot to an open area away from the original spot and restart cleaning.

causes.cause: Stuck on rug fringe or thick carpet

fixSteps.title: Relocate robot
fixSteps.instruction: Pick up and place in different room or open floor area.

whenToCallPro: If error persists on hard flat floors with no obstacles.
videoSearchQuery: Neato pick me up error fix

faq.q: Can I block off problem areas?
faq.a: Yes — use boundary markers in the app or magnetic strips.

title: Brush jam
shortDescription: The combo brush is tangled and not turning.
fullDescription:
Neato D-shape combo brush gets bound by hair and threads. The brush motor stalls and the LCD shows 'Please clean my brush'.

Remove the brush guard, lift out the brush, and clear hair from both end bearings.

fixSteps.title: Remove brush guard
fixSteps.instruction: Lift the yellow tabs and pull off guard.

fixSteps.title: Lift brush and clean
fixSteps.instruction: Pull brush out, remove end caps, cut hair away.

whenToCallPro: If brush motor is silent.

faq.a: Spiral picks up more pet hair; combo is better for fine debris.

title: Wheel error
shortDescription: A drive wheel is jammed or sensor failed.
fullDescription:
Neato error 3 indicates a wheel motor stall. Most often caused by debris but can also be a failed encoder.

Clear the wheel and verify it spins freely.

fixSteps.title: Inspect both wheels
fixSteps.instruction: Flip robot and clear all debris from each wheel.

whenToCallPro: If cleaning does not resolve.

faq.a: Yes — full wheel modules sell for around $50.

title: Side brush jam
fullDescription:
On D7/D8/D9 with side brush, error 5 means the side brush has stopped turning, usually from tangled hair.

Unscrew the brush, clear the post, reattach.

fixSteps.title: Clean post
fixSteps.instruction: Pull all hair from post and bearing.

whenToCallPro: Rarely.

faq.a: Every 6-12 months.

title: Drop sensor blocked
fullDescription:
The drop sensors below the bumper detect stairs. Error 6 means one is dirty or it sees an unusual surface.

Wipe each sensor with a soft dry cloth.

fixSteps.title: Wipe sensors
fixSteps.instruction: Clean four drop sensors under the bumper.

whenToCallPro: If error returns immediately after cleaning.

faq.a: IR sensors can misread very dark or shiny surfaces.

title: Battery issue
shortDescription: Battery low or unable to charge.
fullDescription:
Battery error 7 indicates the lithium pack is depleted or no longer holding charge. Capacity drops noticeably after about 18 months of daily use.

Replace with genuine Neato pack.

fixSteps.title: Clean contacts
fixSteps.instruction: Wipe dock and robot with alcohol.

fixSteps.title: Replace battery
fixSteps.instruction: Open base, swap pack, screws to torque.

whenToCallPro: If new battery does not resolve.

faq.a: Genuine packs typically last longer and are safer.

title: Cannot charge
shortDescription: Robot is on dock but not charging.
fullDescription:
Error 8 indicates voltage from the dock is not reaching the battery. Causes include dirty contacts, failed adapter, or main board.

Verify dock LED is on and contacts are clean.
whenToCallPro: If charger and contacts are good.

faq.a: Solid green = ready, off = no power.

title: Bumper stuck
fullDescription: If the front bumper does not fully release, error 9 prevents driving. Tap firmly and clear any debris in the bumper gap.

fixSteps.title: Press bumper repeatedly
fixSteps.instruction: Push and release bumper several times to free it.

whenToCallPro: If switch is broken.

faq.a: Pet kibble and small toys jam the bumper most.

title: Lidar tower error
fullDescription:
Neato's signature spinning lidar can fail if blocked or if the motor wears. Error 11 stops mapping and cleaning.

Clean tower window and ensure free spin.

fixSteps.title: Inspect tower
fixSteps.instruction: Check that the laser turret rotates freely.

whenToCallPro: Lidar replacement is delicate — pro recommended.

faq.a: No — sealed bearings, do not open.

title: Dustbin / filter error
fullDescription: Neato detects when the dustbin is missing or improperly seated, and reports filter blockage via fan current. Empty bin, tap out filter, or replace filter if old.

fixSteps.title: Empty bin and clean filter
fixSteps.instruction: Slide bin out, empty, tap filter clean.

fixSteps.title: Reseat
fixSteps.instruction: Push bin firmly until it clicks.

whenToCallPro: Rarely.

faq.a: Tap clean only — water damages HEPA media.

title: Main brush is jammed
shortDescription: The main brush motor is blocked
fullDescription: Neato reports 'Brush Stuck' to indicate the main brush motor is blocked. The robot stops and the message appears in the Neato app.

fixSteps.title: Power cycle
fixSteps.instruction: Hold the start button 15 seconds to reboot.

fixSteps.title: Specific repair
fixSteps.instruction: Remove brush, cut and pull all debris.

fixSteps.title: Clean sensors
fixSteps.instruction: Wipe drop sensors and LIDAR turret with dry cloth.

fixSteps.title: Test cleaning
fixSteps.instruction: Start a small spot clean to verify resolution.

whenToCallPro: If the error persists after the LIDAR turret is cleared and the robot is reset, the LIDAR module may need replacement.

faq.a: The main brush motor is blocked.
Remove brush, cut and pull all debris.

faq.q: Are these errors covered by warranty?
faq.a: Hardware faults within the warranty period are covered by Neato.
